From fea3fdf975dd9f3e5248afaab8fe023db313f005 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jiasheng Jiang <jiasheng@iscas.ac.cn>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2021 09:41:26 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/ast: potential dereference of null pointer

The return value of kzalloc() needs to be checked.
To avoid use of null pointer '&ast_state->base' in case of the
failure of alloc.

Fixes: f0adbc382b8b ("drm/ast: Allocate initial CRTC state of the correct size")
Signed-off-by: Jiasheng Jiang <jiasheng@iscas.ac.cn>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Zimmermann <tzimmermann@suse.de>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20211214014126.2211535-1-jiasheng@iscas.ac.cn

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c
index 1e30eaeb0e1b..d5c98f79d58d 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c
@@ -1121,7 +1121,10 @@ static void ast_crtc_reset(struct drm_crtc *crtc)
 	if (crtc->state)
 		crtc->funcs->atomic_destroy_state(crtc, crtc->state);
 
-	__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
+	if (ast_state)
+		__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
+	else
+		__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, NULL);
 }
 
 static struct drm_crtc_state *
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications:

**File Modified: `drivers/gpu/drm/ast/ast_mode.c`**
- The code modification includes an additional null pointer check for `ast_state` before calling `__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset()`.
- If `ast_state` is null, it passes `NULL` to `__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset()` instead of `&ast_state->base`, preventing potential dereference of a null pointer that could occur if `kzalloc()` (presumably used earlier to allocate `ast_state`) fails.

### Relationship:
- The modification addresses a potential bug introduced in a previous commit (`f0adbc382b8b`), where `ast_state` might not have been initialized correctly due to the lack of a check after its allocation. This patch ensures that the code gracefully handles the failure of memory allocation and avoids dereferencing a null pointer, which could lead to crashes or undefined behavior during runtime.

        Root cause:
        The bug arises from the lack of a check for the return value of `kzalloc()`, which allocates memory for `ast_state`. If the allocation fails, `ast_state` would be null, leading to a dereference of a null pointer when accessing `&ast_state->base` in the `__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset()` function. This can cause crashes or undefined behavior in the program.
        
        Commit message:

+		__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, &ast_state->base);
+	else
+		__drm_atomic_helper_crtc_reset(crtc, NULL);
